scripts.dev: pnpm zig:build && pnpm rust:build && pnpm go:build && pnpm --filter @ziglive/protocol build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "cargo run --manifest-path apps/server-rs/Cargo.toml" "pnpm --filter @ziglive/web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm zig:build test && pnpm rust:build && pnpm rust:test && pnpm go:build && pnpm go:test && pnpm ts:test && pnpm py:test && pnpm cfamily:test && cargo test --manifest-path apps/server-rs/Cargo.toml && pnpm --filter @ziglive/protocol build && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.build: pnpm zig:build && pnpm rust:build && pnpm go:build && pnpm -r build && cargo build --release --manifest-path apps/server-rs/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts packages/protocol/src tests playwright.config.ts scripts && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/server-rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
